method: Projected-ring width fit to the original black sprite at an assumed orthographic 54 degrees. Bounded profile deformations and a style penalty retain the new side-inspired carving where consistent with the original. Real-render validation is separate.

camera_refit.method: Uniform image scale and x/y translation fitted to the actual rendered silhouette against the original black sprite at quarter resolution; no geometry or camera elevation changes.

actual_render_refinement.method: Bounded adjustments to the new profile using a projected-ring approximation calibrated to its actual prior render. Original Lichess sprite weighted as target.
